prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: NPC086 pixel-art facial animation atlas for a game portrait.
Primary request: Edit Image 2, the exact 2x2 eye atlas grid. Create a restrained AFRAID expression using worried inner brows and slightly alert lid tension. Use Image 1 only as the original identity and color reference. Ignore Image 3.
Input images: Image 1 = original native 64x64 portrait, identity/palette reference. Image 2 = eyes-reference-grid, exact 2x2 repeated upper 64x35 portrait halves, use as edit target and framing guide. Image 3 = mouth grid, ignore.
Composition/framing: One borderless 2-column by 2-row atlas, exact 64:35 aspect ratio. Every cell is the full same upper 64x35 portrait half, aligned identically to Image 2. Row-major cells: open / half-closed / closed / repeat-open. No labels, gutters, panel borders, added crop, or resized face.
Style/medium: Preserve the original soft-contrast pixel-art raster and its native pixel-grid character. Keep the same muted warm-tan skin, dark brown hair, olive-brown eye shadows, small brown irises, and original soft highlights. No smooth vector eyes, circles, or airbrushed gradients.
Fear expression: Inner brows gently pinch upward and together with restrained worry; lids become a little more alert, not dramatically round or alarmed. Keep both brows the same shape and position in all four cells. Keep brow shape inside the original 086 brow area at rows 17–20. Keep orbital creases unchanged.
Eye geometry lock: Match the original iris and pupil width, shape, color, gaze, and exact native position in every phase. Do not enlarge, round, stretch, shrink, raise, shift, or move either iris or pupil. Keep each tiny highlight at the exact same grid position. Half-closed phase changes eyelid coverage vertically over the stationary eye; it does not move or reshape the iris and must not carry any iris/highlight pixel through the lower eyelid. Closed phase fully hides iris and sclera beneath the lid. Final repeat-open cell repeats the first open eye geometry exactly.
Constraints: Change only brows and eye/lid expression inside the source eye area; preserve all other source pixels and complete portrait framing. Keep original eye spacing and face alignment. No oversized anime eyes, no big white areas, no new catchlights, no gaze jump, no red/orange palette, no thick near-black brows, no added eyelash spikes, no text or watermark.
